unbiased_TCC.limitation: Different AC amplitude from DC-bias curve; cannot substitute for temperature-under-bias behavior.

biased_TCC.limitation: This is combined DC-bias/temperature typical evidence at 5V only. Separate 25C bias values differ slightly; no guaranteed envelope or 5.5V biased-temperature curve is provided.

factors.name: DC-bias retention
factors.status: Primary numeric typical curve at the specified test conditions; not production minimum.

factors.name: initial tolerance
factors.status: Manufacturer initial -10% tolerance; multiplication into typical curves is an engineering screen, not combined guarantee.

factors.name: temperature retention
factors.status: Illustrative allowance lower than the observed 0.83466 worst ratio within the 5V biased-temperature curve. Does not establish a bound at 5.5V, other AC levels, aging or lot corners.

factors.name: AC retention
factors.status: Ratio of separate typical zero-DC AC curve minimum to its 0.5Vrms reference. Validates concern about small ripple, not independence or combined bias/temperature behavior.

factors.name: aging retention
factors.status: Unqualified 10% scenario allowance. Service lifetime, aging rate and de-aging state not established.

factors.name: model/lot reserve
factors.status: Unqualified 10% scenario allowance. No statistical or production lower bound.

crosscheck_limit: Uses directly combined typical temperature and 5V curve instead of 0.80; AC/aging/model assumptions still apply. Do not use as 5.5V guarantee.
baseline_comparison: Nominal 2x10uF retained in baseline; exact combined Ceff at 5/5.5V remains unknown. No numerical improvement ratio against baseline actual Ceff can be claimed.
decision: Plausible margin-bearing validation candidate under this explicit screen: worst requested endpoint gives 6.925uF single  versus 3 µF, or 13.849 µF pair  versus 8 µF. This does not release any bank.
